headline: Record revenue and operating profit
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 3.76T, up 30.3% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 690.9B, up 165.5% y/y and 56.9% q/q, for an operating margin of 18.4%.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the preliminary filing describes both revenue and operating profit as the highest quarterly figures in company history. Operating margin was 18.4% against 9.0% a year earlier. The company gave no numerical guidance for the next quarter. No drivers are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results. Shard operating income (KRW 1,068B) does not match the reported KRW 690.9B and is not used.
